answer: Greg Abel is the Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway as of August 2026. He assumed the role on January 1, 2026, following the Board's unanimous vote in May 2025 to appoint him as CEO. He succeeded Warren Buffett, who had served as CEO for more than 60 years and continues as Chairman of the Board. Abel, 63, previously served as Vice Chairman of Non-Insurance Operations at Berkshire Hathaway from 2018 to 2025.
